rejected_provider_claims: GEMM operation counts inserted an extra width-512 dimension and disagree with their own arithmetic.
limitations: These are arithmetic and payload counts, not measured throughput or latency.
An activation read and upload move one 16384-byte activation payload twice; they do not create 32768 bytes of unique activation state.
The default workload fits the host GPU; policy-forced placement is not larger-than-physical-capacity proof.
AMD integrated shared memory is not an external dedicated 8GB card.
Actual copy counts depend on the reviewed executor and whether parity readbacks are reused at boundaries.
